_meta.note: Illustrations are static SVG files under remotion/public/illustrations/. Icons and Open Peeps characters are resolved dynamically at render time (see src/icons.js and src/peeps.js) rather than stored as files, so they are indexed here by name only. Illustration tags are auto-derived from filenames plus a heuristic category; icon name-lists include a 'categories' grouping (keyword-based, not exhaustive) to narrow searches before an exact or substring name match. Enriched by Claude on 2026-07-20.
